description: Publish a PDF, Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx), Excel (.xlsx/.xls), or CSV file as a browser-viewable page, private by default. Accepts filename and base64 content, up to 4 MB decoded. Documents become readable PDFs, slides have presentation controls, and spreadsheets have searchable sheet tabs. Preserves the original for download. A siteId replaces the page at the same address. Does not send invitations.

content.description: Base64 file bytes, not a local path or URL.

filename.description: Original file name with extension, e.g. proposal.docx.

siteId.description: Replace this existing page at the same address.

siteName.description: Name shown to the user and recipients, e.g. "Q3 report".

slug.description: Optional address label, 3-40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens. Random when omitted.

visibility.description: private (invitation-only, default) or public (anyone with the link).

name: publish_document
title: Publish document
